### Bible Pathway - March 28
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-28-2013.html
Passage: Judges 16:20
Points:
- Samson neglected his sacred Nazirite calling and indulged in worldly, sinful relationships.
- Presuming upon God's enduring patience, he failed to recognize the danger of Delilah's entrapment.
- His greatest tragedy occurred when the Lord departed from him without his realization.
- Spiritual compromise stripped him of his strength and led directly to blindness and captivity.
- Believers must not squander their gifts on self-indulgence, but instead seek first God's kingdom.
